findings.issue: No workflow runs cargo test, just test, or pytest on tests/fixtures/jev-python. Only sc-publish-dry-run.yml runs on PRs (kit preflight, cargo publish --dry-run, maturin build). The three Python test files are never executed by any configured command; Rust suite never run under CI parallelism / clean runner.
findings.recommendation: Add a CI job running cargo test --workspace and maturin develop + pytest tests/fixtures/jev-python with hard job timeouts; add pytest as a second [[tool.sc-lint.test]] layer. No retries.
findings.evidence: sc-lint.toml defines only workspace cargo test; grep .github for cargo test|pytest|jev-python matches only kit tests

findings.issue: default_log_root_is_under_sc_agent (and Python twin test_module_documents_log_root) asserts against the real process env; with HOME and USERPROFILE unset (env -i, minimal container) it falls to temp_dir and fails.
findings.recommendation: Extract pure default_log_root_from(home: Option<OsString>, tmp: &Path); test both branches with injected inputs.
findings.evidence: logging.rs:120-125 env read; 239-248 assertion with no env control

findings.issue: Subprocess tests (sc-ai cli.rs:672, tests/jev_cross_impl/main.rs:25, sc-treesitter/tests/cli.rs) use wait_with_output()/output() with no deadline; a blocking child hangs to the CI timeout. sc-treesitter git helpers inherit global git config.
findings.recommendation: Spawn helper polling try_wait against a 60s deadline, kill+reap, panic with stderr; set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 on git helpers.
